text: This place is so huge, what is it?
I guess it's the tower in Mithurna, the Diel's\ncountry. It was said that one time a rival country\ncalled Slebinia
planted a magic bomb that emitted powerful magic\nto wipe out Mithurna.
Nope. It was said that a brave adventurer managed\nto destroy the bomb and it was a happy ending.
The tower was still standing firm after that.\nHowever, when the cataclysm happened, it became\nburied in the ground like this...
I see...It's been bugging me for a while, why do\nyou know so much about such legend?
It's nothing. When I was a child...long before\nI came to Einklang as a refugee...
I lived in Rugio Town and I used to work in a\nbookstore for some pocket money. Whenever I was\nfree, I'd read the books and I learned a lot...
I see.\nI din't know that you were that\ndiligent...
Hahaha, what did you think of me?!
